routing.reason: Clear bounded scope for pilot delegation

structured_spec.feature_identity: First Real OR Pilot for Bounded Janus Delegation
structured_spec.user_value: Delegable low-risk Janus work to cheaper external worker path without losing local validation, diff review, or final acceptance control.
structured_spec.user_action_surface: Initiate quickchange, review diff, accept or reject handoff.
structured_spec.system_behavior: Returns reviewable diff, changed-files list, validation evidence, explicit Codex-owned accept-or-reject handoff. Fallback to local Codex handling on failure.
structured_spec.data_persistence: Store diff, validation evidence, and handoff status locally.
structured_spec.constraints: Allowlisted quickchange only. No delete/rename/move. No multi-task.
structured_spec.security_privacy: No authority drift. Local validation maintained.
structured_spec.edge_cases: Missing artifact, allowlist escape, touched-file-cap escape, failed validation.
definition_of_done: One tiny allowlisted quickchange returns a reviewable diff
Explicit Codex-owned accept-or-reject handoff with no authority drift
structured_spec.test_strategy: Verify diff generation, validate allowlist, test fallback on missing artifacts, confirm no authority drift.
structured_spec.internal_complexity_breakdown: Low complexity pilot. Focus on routing logic and validation hooks.
